added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: the two cases assert only dimension_dispositions, so the merge of responses and response_events — two of the three fields the section requires — has no assertion; removing the responses and response_events assignments from _merge_record_answers leaves both cases green (2 passed EXIT=0), so a regression dropping those merges would pass the node's whole gate.

follow-on: _staging_copies_of_record reads review_store_root() with no base_dir, while stored_record and record_dimension_disposition still thread base_dir through, so a stored_record(project, run, base_dir=X) caller selects from X but merges its answers from the default store, and record_dimension_disposition writes the merged record back to the X file — with a non-default base_dir this copies another store's answers into X. No production caller passes base_dir today, so the path is test-only.

follow-on: the reviewed manifest declares no baseline_suite or after_suite arm (its test_logs name the head gate and the negative control only), so the store's added-failure derivation reads unmeasured (null) rather than a measured zero; recording the two arms would let a later reader derive the delta this one-arm evidence cannot.
